raw_response:
Answer: B
Reason: The teardrop-shaped opacity at the caudal end of the azygos fissure represents the azygos vein. In the presence of a pneumothorax, air can enter the potential space between the layers of the azygos mesentery, displacing the azygos vein medially and leaving the fissure empty, which results in the absence of the characteristic teardrop opacity on the radiograph.
